name: ArXivMath
intro: ArXivMath 是 MathArena 按月更新的研究级数学最终答案基准。它从上一个月新发布的 arXiv 数学论文中生成候选问题，经自动过滤、人工审查和论文作者复核后发布，使用符号解析、LLM 交叉检查与人工仲裁评估模型答案。
build_method: 按月抓取 arXiv 数学论文, LLM 生成候选问题, 自动过滤, 人工审查, 论文作者复核
metric: 最终答案准确率（4次运行取平均）, 推理成本
eval_feature: 按月动态更新, 研究级数学, 污染缓解, 符号等价判定
scale: 每月约200个候选问题，经筛选后发布约30题
build_method_en: Monthly arXiv mathematics ingestion, LLM candidate generation, automated filtering, human review, and paper-author review
eval_feature_en: Monthly dynamic refresh, research-level mathematics, contamination mitigation, symbolic-equivalence grading
intro_en: ArXivMath is MathArena's monthly research-level final-answer mathematics benchmark. Candidate questions are generated from mathematics papers published on arXiv in the previous month, then pass automated filtering, human review, and paper-author review before release; answers are graded with symbolic parsing, LLM cross-checks, and human adjudication.
scale_en: About 200 candidate questions per month, filtered to about 30 released questions
metric_en: Final-answer accuracy averaged over four runs, inference cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.00674 Sections 2-4 and the MathArena ArXivMath methodology: monthly collection of the previous month's arXiv mathematics papers; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview candidate generation from titles and abstracts; roughly 200 candidates per month; automated checks for self-containment, missing context, guessability, explicit AI use, and author expertise; DeepSeek-OCR-2 paper conversion to recover assumptions; manual and paper-author review; release of roughly 30 questions per month; four default-parameter runs without tools; SymPy-based final-answer parsing with model restatement for formatting errors; LLM cross-checking and human adjudication of disagreements; and accuracy, cost, and monthly-version reporting.
